definitions.explanation: Money offered as a prize for winning a contest or competition, or as a reward for information or the capture of a wanted person.

examples.japanese: {懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧です。
examples.english: The prize money is one million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かけられた。
examples.english: A bounty was placed on the criminal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{提供者|ていきょうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{三百万|さんびゃくまん}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われる→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: An informant can receive up to three million yen in reward money.

notes:
Composed of {懸賞|けんしょう} (prize/reward) + {金|きん} (money). Used in two main contexts: prize money for contests and competitions, and reward money for information leading to the capture of criminals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put up a reward/bounty
- {懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a reward is offered
- {懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a bounty attached
- {懸賞金|けんしょうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive the prize/reward money

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賞金|しょうきん}→賞金：14234_shoukin⟧: prize money — for competitions, without the "bounty" connotation
- ⟦{報奨金|ほうしょうきん}→報奨金：18793_houshoukin⟧: incentive money/bonus — for good performance or tips
- {褒賞金|ほうしょうきん}: reward money — formal, from government or organizations
